maddeler.e: إِسْمَاعِيلِيّ • (ʔismāʕīliyy) (feminine إِسْمَاعِيلِيَّة (ʔismāʕīliyya), masculine plural إِسْمَاعِيلِيُّون (ʔismāʕīliyyūn), feminine plural إِسْمَاعِيلِيَّات (ʔismāʕīliyyāt))
maddeler.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic إِسْمَاعِيل (ʔismāʕīl)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic إسماعيلي
From إِسْمَاعِيل (ʔismāʕīl, “Ismail”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: related to or associated with an Ismail
of a dynasty whose eponym is an Ismail, Ismailid
related to or associated with an Ismail
related to or associated with the city of Ismailia
related to or associated with an Ismail
related to or associated with Ismail bin Jafar, Ismaili
